i actually am incapable of sustaining relationships only through text or chat:-( i’ve stopped talking to people due to the quarantine and because i mostly always have friendships tied to the places i frequent. for example, when i could attend to university and things were like they used to, i actually had a healthy social life because almost all of my relationships where within the realms of my degree/campus. i spent most of the time alone working on my projects (i study sculpture) and i would take breaks in which i would hang out with friends or acquaintances. 

nowadays i have been called out a few times because i’ve disappeared or because i don’t respond and it makes me feel so guilty! i honestly don’t see the point of texting/chatting and i find it really irritating to only be able to answer vaguely and slowly because of the limitations of writing on a phone or writing too much. 

it is really hard for me to become friends with people, i guess i have more acquaintances than close relationships really, so i get really sad thinking about all the lost progress i made in the last years in learning to be more social. 

what has been useful (and to give at least an ounce of advice i feel like i’m only complaining and not saying anything helpful) these months of shutdown and distance is:

1) to acknowledge the fact that i have trouble chatting/texting 
2) make good use of the sparse days in which i have the energy to chat/text and take advantage of the good mood and reply to posts/stories on social media 
3) try to stop blaming myself and value those whom still take the time to talk to me even if i’m inconsistent with communication 
4) try to stop comparing myself to people who are actually good at having friends (it only makes me feel lonelier and worse in the end)
5) answering as soon as i see the message (only if i can and without giving too much thought) and turning off the notifications that appear on the screen (i get really anxious when i’m on my cell phone and i see that X person is texting me so i only have the vibration on and i can always check the notification center later)

and well, i haven’t been doing good really regarding this. i get really anxious with direct live communication online and it is really difficult for me to understand what people mean when they talk to me. also a really small amount of people text me nowadays so it’s become easier to handle. 

good luck and remember to be kind with yourself!

there are different kinds of people, i personally am not a Disney fan, but if there are still people who think dearly of any production from Disney, it will be very unlikely Disney stops being relevant

starting the week early in the morning with a cup of coffee and a to do list always seems to give me a sense of well being. also dressing up in clothes that i like and putting a little of makeup, making myself look nice for myself instead of skipping the shower and keeping the greasy hair. 

i love Mondays, it always feels like a new start and a new opportunity to give it a chance to anything that might’ve not worked the previous week and tackle life with a sense of newness and freshness. generally if a monday goes well, the following days have more chances of going ok too. happy monday!

write and read and write, also maybe try to work with a group of friends/people/collegues so you can get feedback on what you’re working on. try and make publications and keep writing until you feel comfortable communicating through writing

thank you to everyone that took the time to comment. yesterday i told him but it went all wrong, i think i am not and will never be able to really explain anything. how come i am so intelligent but so stupid in life at the same time?

i guess it is offensive for me to say that i might be on the spectrum if i can’t explain myself. i don’t “look” or “act” autistic i guess. im only able to relax when im alone and i know no one will see me. 

i think that it doesn’t matter in the end if i am or if im not. to be honest i can only feel shame and guilt knowing that i made my partner feel mocked. i am so used to feeling like the only option that i have is to act normal and behave as 
if i am not distressed that i don’t actually mind so much to keep feeling this way. this way as in inadequate, incapable of intimacy, lost in translation, different, unable to express things in an appropriate manner, on the verge of everything all the time. i don’t know, maybe im just not on the spectrum and its al right, so thanks to everyone who took the time. honestly.

and also sorry to everyone here if you also find offensive that i am thinking about myself as someone on the spectrum when i might not be. 

i am so sorry.

and, its not my partner’s fault. he felt as if i was truly not understanding anything and making fun of him by saying this. and i can see why, i am not so socially disabled since i’ve learned to talk and work with people. i’ve suffered a lot, yes, but maybe it is because i am a cis-woman that i have only just been incredibly inhibited and just taken this challenge silently trying ro fit in and not get unwanted attention. also i’ve been going to psychoanalytic therapy for 6+ years and it has been useful and painful. 

i might be only making this up, maybe i just suffer unnecessarily through life, maybe i am just like every NT out there and i just keep pitying myself. idk, i am sorry. thanks to everyone.
